topics.description: The Trump administration has deferred $91 million in Minnesota Medicaid funding citing fraud vulnerabilities. This has raised concerns about the state's ability to manage Medicaid funds.
topics.reason: The deferment of Medicaid funding is a significant development in the ongoing investigation into fraud in Minnesota.

topics.description: The Feeding Our Future investigation has led to the charging of several individuals, including Aimee Bock, for alleged wire fraud and money laundering.
topics.reason: The investigation into Feeding Our Future has uncovered significant allegations of fraud.
